name: The Tower of Althalaxx
summary: Dark rites at the Tower of Althalaxx threaten northern Darkshore. Balthule Shadowstrike leads an Alliance assault on Athrikus Narassin, the ancient sorcerer who commands the cult from the tower’s peak.

sections.title: Breaching the Summit
sections.body: In northern Darkshore, the ruined Tower of Althalaxx shelters demonic rites. Balthule Shadowstrike watches from nearby and sees the danger must be faced now. Athrikus Narassin, an ancient night elf warlock, dwells at the summit. Beneath the shattered roof, he directs the dark rituals.

sections.title: A Decisive Strike
sections.body: Athrikus Narassin is guarded by loyal warlocks and magic more dangerous than that of the cultists on the slopes. You must cut through his inner circle and take his severed head as proof. Balthule warns the demonic forces may gather again. Yet Athrikus’s death leaves the cult without its commander and brings Darkshore a measure of safety.

faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin is an ancient night elf warlock who commands the cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx. He directs dark summonings and demonic rites among the ruins of northern Darkshore.

faq.q: Where can Athrikus Narassin be found?
faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin dwells at the summit of the Tower of Althalaxx. Seasoned warlocks and summoned minions guard him.
Balthule Shadowstrike, an Alliance scout camped near the base of the Tower of Althalaxx, asks you to slay Athrikus.

faq.q: Who is Delgren mentioned in the quest?
faq.answer: Delgren the Purifier is a nearby Alliance ally. He sent you to coordinate with Balthule against the demonic cabal.

faq.q: What happens after Athrikus is defeated?
faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin’s death deals a critical blow to demonic operations in the area. Balthule warns that the dark forces may gather again.

faq.q: Why is the Tower of Althalaxx dangerous to Darkshore?
faq.answer: Cultists and warlocks in the tower practice fel sorcery and summon demons into night elven lands. They threaten the wilderness and nearby settlements.

angles.text: As a night elf, facing Athrikus Narassin recalls the arcane and demonic corruption that once devastated your people.
As a warlock, you see in Athrikus’s potent demonic magic at Althalaxx’s summit the danger of unbound fel worship.
As an Alliance member, helping secure northern Darkshore protects travel between Auberdine and the lands beyond.
